figures.finding: No collective agreement sets an Austrian film actor's pay: the film workers' agreement (Kollektivvertrag für Filmberufe) excludes performers and extras, and the Austrian film actors' association says there is no binding framework for film actors, so terms are negotiated.

sources.said: The Federal capital and seat of the highest Federal authorities is Vienna.

figures.finding: Austrian film and television is made in German, the official language: the Austrian Film Commission says Austrian films usually speak German and other-language films are the exception, and the Austrian Film Institute funds a film only if a final version is made in German (dubbed or subtitled) or a recognised minority language.

value.basis: Austrian Film Commission (AFC Review 2016); ÖFI Richtlinien 2026 3.5.3; constitution (B-VG Art. 8)
value.exceptions: other-language films (English, French and others) are made, as the exception

figures.applies: Austria, film and television; the AFC's review of 2016 and the ÖFI guidelines of 2026.

figures.finding: The agreement's minimum monthly fixed pay for a soloist (the minimum of § 15 with the flat Sunday, holiday and night supplement of § 14 (4)) is €2,558.22 from 1 July 2026, €2,616.52 from 1 August 2027 and €2,675.72 from 1 September 2028; the agreement counts its performers as soloists, chorus and ballet corps, and the game reads an actor's part as a soloist's. A 13th and 14th month's pay is owed on it (§ 18), whole for a full season's engagement and a proportional share otherwise, which the game doesn't pay. Until 2026-11-04 the research held no amount: the deposit notice of KV 230/2026 gave the dates of its three steps only.

value.agreement: KV 267/2020 (Zusatz-KV of 12 May 2020) as raised by KV 230/2026 (6 March 2026)
value.specialPayments: 13th and 14th month (§ 18), a proportional share where the engagement is shorter than the season; not paid by the game

figures.applies: Austria, soloists at the theatres that are members of the Bühnenverein österreichischer Bundesländer und Städte; the agreement as the ÖGB register shows it on 4 November 2026. The 2028 row prints a supplement of 389.69 beside a total of 2,675.72, which 2,277.21 and 389.69 do not make; the total is the agreement's and is the one held.
